item1.justification: The trace applies element-specific single-reference anticipation analysis under §102, expressly addresses the Graham factors and motivation to combine under §103, and compares claims 19–24 with specification support under §112(a).

item2.justification: The conclusions are tied to specific formula limitations, US-2013242770-A1, and specification paragraphs [0036], [0086], and [0089].

item3.justification: The later allowance of claims 13–18 and §112 rejection of claims 19–24 are consistent with the earlier novelty and obviousness findings because patentability over prior art does not establish written-description support.

item4.justification: The moderate-strictness, low-combination-threshold profile is reasonably reflected because the examiner pragmatically evaluates combination motivation but finds no complementary teaching or suggestion from which even an easy combination could be made.

item5.justification: The final decision directly follows the office action by granting claims 13–18 and recommending amendment of claims 19–24 based on the same identified network-node written-description deficiency.
